'''Mongo Beefhead''' were a species of individuals on the edge of [[Death/Legends|extinction]]. The group was native to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Tales of Phantom Toys" /> and were members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="binder" /> The [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[mutant]] [[Zeta Magnus]] [[Diet/Legends|consumed]] Mongo Beefhead meat, though it was nutritionally poor.<ref name="SkyeWalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Mongo Beefhead Tribe comes from a prototype action figure envisioned by [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] for ''[[The Epic Continues]]'', a canceled [[1986]] toy line. Designers created the original figure, named the [[Mongo Beefhead Tribesman]], by taking the head of a "Squid Head" ([[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]]) action figure, cutting off its neck, and turning it to face the front.<ref name="Tales of Phantom Toys" /> The head was then combined with the torso of a Squid Head figure, the arms from a "Hammer Head" ([[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]]), and the chest pack from [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]]<ref name="binder" /> ([[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]]).
